lesson.title: 7.6 She likes dancing
lesson.unit_title: Everyday needs, plans and free time
lesson.unit_outcome: Say what hurts and why someone feels a certain way, describe what people are wearing and the weather as it happens, tell someone to put on or take off clothes, talk about what people like doing, invite and answer, ask someone to repeat or explain, talk about being sick, the months and seasons, compare with the biggest and the tallest, and say what people and animals can do and are good at.
lesson.goal: Say what people like doing with like/likes + -ing (She likes dancing.), ask Does she like…? and What do you like doing?.
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 7.6 What I Like to Do: A1 says I like to + verb (I like to dance.); A1+ 7.6 says what other people like doing. The one new grammar relationship is like/likes + the -ing form of the activity (She likes dancing. / I like painting.), with he/she + likes (the -s of A1+ 1.2), the question Does she like …? with the short answers Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't. (A1+ 1.8-1.9), and What do you like doing?. A1 7.6's activity photos come back, and the cast's own photos give the first-person answers.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 7.6 I like to + the eight activities; A1+ 1.2 he/she + -s; A1+ 1.8 doesn't; A1+ 1.9 Does …?; A1+ 3.3 -ing.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say likes with a clear s (LAIKS) and the -ing ending as one soft syllable (DAN-sing, PAIN-ting). Do not require native-like speed.

models.text: Does she like drawing? Yes, she does.
What do you like doing? I like painting.

items.text: Does she like drawing? Yes, she does.
What do you like doing? I like painting.
items.es: ¿Qué te gusta hacer? Me gusta pintar.
